newsitem.title: USA: Disgruntled employee shoots six in S. Calif..
newsitem.headline: Disgruntled employee shoots six in S. Calif..

text.p: An apparently disruntled employee walked into a plastics company complex Thursday and shot six people, killing one of them, police said.
The gunman, described as a bearded Hispanic man, escaped in a car after the shooting and police launched a manhunt in the suburb of Santa Fe Springs, some 20 miles south of Los Angeles.
Police said one man was found dead inside the building and five other people were wounded at the Omni Plastics Co. complex.
Two of the five people shot were in serious condition and taken to a local hospital. The other three had less serious injuries, Whittier police said.
